    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(poster)

    # Load fonts
    try:
        font_title = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD, 96)
        font_subtitle = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_REGULAR, 36)
        font_section = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD, 48)
        font_body = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_REGULAR, 32)
        font_stat_num = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD, 90)
        font_stat_label = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_MEDIUM, 26)
        font_stat_context = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_REGULAR, 22)
        font_callout = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD, 38)
        font_small = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_REGULAR, 24)
        font_insight = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_MEDIUM, 28)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Font loading error: {e}, using default")
        font_title = ImageFont.load_default()
        font_subtitle = font_title
        font_section = font_title
        font_body = font_title
        font_stat_num = font_title
        font_stat_label = font_title
        font_stat_context = font_title
        font_callout = font_title
        font_small = font_title
        font_insight = font_title

    # Margins
    MARGIN = 80
    content_w = W_PX - 2 * MARGIN

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════
    # SECTION 1: TITLE BAR
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════
    y = 60
    title_bar_h = 270

    # Title bar background
    draw.rectangle([(MARGIN, y), (W_PX - MARGIN, y + title_bar_h)],
                   fill=BG_RAISED, outline=BORDER, width=2)

    # Accent stripe on left
    draw.rectangle([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 8, y + title_bar_h)], fill=BLUE)

    # Title
    title_text = "Frontier AI Models Compared"
    draw.text((MARGIN + 50, y + 30), title_text, fill=TEXT_PRI, font=font_title)

    # Subtitle
    subtitle = "Intelligence · Speed · Cost  —  Based on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0"
    draw.text((MARGIN + 50, y + 155), subtitle, fill=TEXT_SEC, font=font_subtitle)

    # Source line
    draw.text((MARGIN + 50, y + 210), "Independent analysis from artificialanalysis.ai  ·  May 2026",
              fill=TEXT_DIM, font=font_small)

    y += title_bar_h + 40

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════
    # SECTION 2: STAT BANNER — Big Numbers
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════
    stat_h = 200
    draw.rectangle([(MARGIN, y), (W_PX - MARGIN, y + stat_h)],
                   fill=BG_RAISED, outline=BORDER, width=1)

    stats = [
        ("57", "Intelligence\nLeaders", "Gemini 3.1 Pro & GPT-5.4\ntied at the top", BLUE),
        ("206", "Fastest\nOutput", "gpt-oss-120B at\n206 tokens/sec", TEAL),
        ("33×", "Price\nRange", "$0.30 → $10.00\nper 1M tokens", AMBER),
        ("10", "Evaluations\nin Index", "Coding, agentic, knowledge\n& reasoning benchmarks", PURPLE),
    ]

    stat_w = content_w // 4
    for i, (num, label, ctx, accent) in enumerate(stats):
        sx = MARGIN + i * stat_w + 30
        # Accent dot
        draw.ellipse([(sx, y + 28), (sx + 12, y + 40)], fill=accent)
        # Number
        draw.text((sx + 20, y + 18), num, fill=TEXT_PRI, font=font_stat_num)
        # Vertical divider (except last)

142	def make_hbar_chart(data, title, xlabel, filename, color, top_n=None,
143	                    highlight_names=None, highlight_color=None,
144	                    value_fmt='{}', sort_reverse=False):
145	    """Generate a horizontal bar chart saved as PNG."""
146	    items = list(reversed(data))  # matplotlib draws bottom-up
147	    names = [SHORT_NAMES.get(d[0], d[0]) for d in items]
148	    values = [d[1] for d in items]
149	
150	    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5), dpi=200)
151	    fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
152	    ax.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
153	
154	    bar_colors = []
155	    for d in items:
156	        if highlight_names and d[0] in highlight_names:
157	            bar_colors.append(highlight_color or color)
158	        else:
159	            bar_colors.append(color)
160	
161	    bars = ax.barh(names, values, color=bar_colors, height=0.65, zorder=3)
162	
163	    # Value labels
164	    for bar, val in zip(bars, values):
165	        ax.text(bar.get_width() + max(values) * 0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
166	                value_fmt.format(val), va='center', fontsize=8.5,
167	                fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRI, fontfamily='sans-serif')
168	
169	    ax.set_xlim(0, max(values) * 1.18)
170	    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SEC, labelsize=8.5, pad=4)
171	    ax.xaxis.set_tick_params(colors=TEXT_SEC)
172	    ax.tick_params(axis='y', colors=TEXT_PRI, labelsize=8.5)
173	    ax.xaxis.label.set_color(TEXT_SEC)
174	    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel, fontsize=8, color=TEXT_SEC, fontfamily='sans-serif')
175	
176	    # Remove spines
177	    for spine in ax.spines.values():
178	        spine.set_visible(False)
179	    ax.grid(axis='x', color=BORDER, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=0)
180	
181	    # Title
182	    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRI,
183	                 pad=12, fontfamily='sans-serif', loc='left')
184	
185	    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.5)
186	    fig.savefig(filename, dpi=200, facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor='none',
187	                bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.15)
188	    plt.close(fig)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate A1 Portrait Poster: Frontier AI Models Compared."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CONFIG
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
OUTPUT = '/app/output/final_poster.png'
DPI = 200
MM_TO_INCH = 1 / 25.4
W_MM, H_MM = 594, 841  # A1 portrait
W_IN, H_IN = W_MM * MM_TO_INCH, H_MM * MM_TO_INCH
W_PX, H_PX = int(W_IN * DPI), int(H_IN * DPI)

# Color palette — dark dashboard
BG_DARK   = '#0b0d14'
BG_CARD   = '#151720'
BG_RAISED = '#1c1f2b'
BORDER    = '#2a2d3a'
TEXT_PRI  = '#f1f5f9'
TEXT_SEC  = '#94a3b8'
TEXT_DIM  = '#64748b'
BLUE      = '#3b82f6'
TEAL      = '#14b8a6'
AMBER     = '#f59e0b'
ROSE      = '#f43f5e'
PURPLE    = '#8b5cf6'
CYAN      = '#06b6d4'

# Font
FONT_BOLD = '/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Bold.otf'
FONT_SEMIBOLD = '/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-SemiBold.otf'
FONT_REGULAR = '/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Regular.otf'
FONT_MEDIUM = '/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Medium.otf'

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

intelligence_data = [
    ("Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview", 57),
    ("GPT-5.4 (xhigh)", 57),
    ("Claude Opus 4.6 (max)", 53),
    ("Muse Spark", 52),
    ("Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)", 52),
    ("GLM-5.1", 51),
    ("Grok 4.20 0309 v2", 49),
    ("Gemini 3 Flash", 46),
    ("DeepSeek V3.2", 42),
    ("NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super", 36),
    ("gpt-oss-120B (high)", 33),
]

speed_data = [
    ("gpt-oss-120B (high)", 206),
    ("NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super", 193),
    ("Grok 4.20 0309 v2", 162),
    ("Gemini 3 Flash", 149),
    ("Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview", 129),
    ("GPT-5.4 (xhigh)", 72),
    ("Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)", 48),
    ("GLM-5.1", 40),
    ("Claude Opus 4.6 (max)", 40),
    ("DeepSeek V3.2", 31),
]

price_data = [
    ("gpt-oss-120B (high)", 0.30),
    ("DeepSeek V3.2", 0.30),
    ("NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super", 0.40),
    ("Gemini 3 Flash", 1.10),
    ("GLM-5.1", 2.10),
    ("Grok 4.20 0309 v2", 3.00),
    ("Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview", 4.50),
    ("GPT-5.4 (xhigh)", 5.60),
    ("Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)", 6.00),
    ("Claude Opus 4.6 (max)", 10.00),
]

# Build combined data for trade-off chart
all_models = {
    "Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview": (57, 129, 4.50),
    "GPT-5.4 (xhigh)": (57, 72, 5.60),
    "Claude Opus 4.6 (max)": (53, 40, 10.00),
    "Muse Spark": (52, None, None),
    "Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)": (52, 48, 6.00),
    "GLM-5.1": (51, 40, 2.10),
    "Grok 4.20 0309 v2": (49, 162, 3.00),
    "Gemini 3 Flash": (46, 149, 1.10),
    "DeepSeek V3.2": (42, 31, 0.30),
    "NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super": (36, 193, 0.40),
    "gpt-oss-120B (high)": (33, 206, 0.30),
}

# Filter models with all three metrics
tradeoff_models = {k: v for k, v in all_models.items() if v[1] is not None and v[2] is not None}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HELPER: Shorten model names
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SHORT_NAMES = {
    "Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview": "Gemini 3.1 Pro",
    "GPT-5.4 (xhigh)": "GPT-5.4",
    "Claude Opus 4.6 (max)": "Claude Opus 4.6",
    "Muse Spark": "Muse Spark",
    "Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)": "Claude Sonnet 4.6",
    "GLM-5.1": "GLM-5.1",
    "Grok 4.20 0309 v2": "Grok 4.20",
    "Gemini 3 Flash": "Gemini 3 Flash",
    "DeepSeek V3.2": "DeepSeek V3.2",
    "NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super": "Nemotron 3 Super",
    "gpt-oss-120B (high)": "gpt-oss-120B",
}

# Model colors (consistent across charts)
MODEL_COLORS = {
    "Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview": '#4285f4',
    "GPT-5.4 (xhigh)": '#10a37f',
    "Claude Opus 4.6 (max)": '#d97706',
    "Muse Spark": '#8b5cf6',
    "Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)": '#f59e0b',
    "GLM-5.1": '#06b6d4',
    "Grok 4.20 0309 v2": '#1e293b',
    "Gemini 3 Flash": '#3b82f6',
    "DeepSeek V3.2": '#6366f1',
    "NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super": '#76b900',
    "gpt-oss-120B (high)": '#64748b',
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CHART GENERATION FUNCTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def make_hbar_chart(data, title, xlabel, filename, color, top_n=None,
                    highlight_names=None, highlight_color=None,
                    value_fmt='{}', sort_reverse=False):
    """Generate a horizontal bar chart saved as PNG."""
    items = list(reversed(data))  # matplotlib draws bottom-up
    names = [SHORT_NAMES.get(d[0], d[0]) for d in items]
    values = [d[1] for d in items]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5), dpi=200)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
    ax.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)

    bar_colors = []
    for d in items:
        if highlight_names and d[0] in highlight_names:
            bar_colors.append(highlight_color or color)
        else:
            bar_colors.append(color)

    bars = ax.barh(names, values, color=bar_colors, height=0.65, zorder=3)

    # Value labels
    for bar, val in zip(bars, values):
        ax.text(bar.get_width() + max(values) * 0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                value_fmt.format(val), va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRI, fontfamily='sans-serif')

    ax.set_xlim(0, max(values) * 1.18)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SEC, labelsize=8.5, pad=4)
    ax.xaxis.set_tick_params(colors=TEXT_SEC)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', colors=TEXT_PRI, labelsize=8.5)
    ax.xaxis.label.set_color(TEXT_SEC)
    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel, fontsize=8, color=TEXT_SEC, fontfamily='sans-serif')

    # Remove spines
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)
    ax.grid(axis='x', color=BORDER, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

    # Title
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRI,
                 pad=12, fontfamily='sans-serif', loc='left')

    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.5)
    fig.savefig(filename, dpi=200, facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor='none',
                bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.15)
    plt.close(fig)


def make_tradeoff_chart(filename):
    """Generate the hero trade-off bubble chart: Intelligence vs Speed, bubble = 1/cost."""
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, 8.5), dpi=200)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
    ax.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)

    x_vals = []
    y_vals = []
    s_vals = []
    c_vals = []
    labels = []

    for name, (iq, speed, price) in tradeoff_models.items():
        x_vals.append(iq)
        y_vals.append(speed)
        # Bubble size proportional to value (1/price), scaled
        s_vals.append((1/price) * 1800)
        c_vals.append(MODEL_COLORS.get(name, CYAN))
        labels.append(SHORT_NAMES.get(name, name))

    # Plot bubbles
    scatter = ax.scatter(x_vals, y_vals, s=s_vals, c=c_vals, alpha=0.85,
                         edgecolors='white', linewidths=1.2, zorder=5)

    # Label key models
    label_offsets = {
        "Gemini 3.1 Pro": (2, -10),
        "GPT-5.4": (2, -6),
        "Claude Opus 4.6": (4, -4),
        "Grok 4.20": (3, 5),
        "Gemini 3 Flash": (-3, 8),
        "gpt-oss-120B": (-4, -8),
        "DeepSeek V3.2": (4, 4),
        "Nemotron 3 Super": (-5, -6),
        "Claude Sonnet 4.6": (3, 3),
        "GLM-5.1": (3, -4),
    }

    for i, label in enumerate(labels):
        ox, oy = label_offsets.get(label, (2, 2))
        ax.annotate(label, (x_vals[i], y_vals[i]),
                    textcoords="offset points", xytext=(ox, oy),
                    fontsize=8, color=TEXT_PRI, fontweight='bold',
                    fontfamily='sans-serif',
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=TEXT_DIM, lw=0.8),
                    zorder=10)

    # Quadrant annotations
    ax.annotate('Smart & Slow\nPremium Tier', xy=(55.2, 28), fontsize=7.5,
                color=TEXT_DIM, ha='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', fontstyle='italic')
    ax.annotate('Smart & Fast\nIdeal Balance', xy=(55.2, 185), fontsize=7.5,
                color=TEXT_DIM, ha='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', fontstyle='italic')
    ax.annotate('Budget & Fast\nValue Zone', xy=(35, 185), fontsize=7.5,
                color=TEXT_DIM, ha='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', fontstyle='italic')
    ax.annotate('Budget & Slow\nNiche Use', xy=(35, 28), fontsize=7.5,
                color=TEXT_DIM, ha='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', fontstyle='italic')

    # Reference lines at median
    ax.axhline(y=np.median(y_vals), color=BORDER, linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, zorder=1)
    ax.axvline(x=np.median(x_vals), color=BORDER, linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, zorder=1)

    ax.set_xlabel('Intelligence Score (AA Index v4.0)  →', fontsize=10, color=TEXT_SEC,
                  fontfamily='sans-serif', labelpad=8)
    ax.set_ylabel('Output Speed (tokens/sec)  →', fontsize=10, color=TEXT_SEC,
                  fontfamily='sans-serif', labelpad=8)
    ax.set_title('Intelligence vs. Speed vs. Cost', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold',
                 color=TEXT_PRI, pad=14, fontfamily='sans-serif', loc='left')

    # Subtitle annotation
    ax.text(0.0, 1.02, 'Bubble size = value (1/price). Larger bubble = more affordable.',
            transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8.5, color=TEXT_DIM,
            fontfamily='sans-serif', fontstyle='italic')

    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SEC, labelsize=9)
    ax.grid(True, color=BORDER, linewidth=0.4, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)

    ax.set_xlim(28, 62)
    ax.set_ylim(10, 235)

    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.8)
    fig.savefig(filename, dpi=200, facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor='none',
                bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.2)
    plt.close(fig)


def make_price_chart(data, filename):
    """Generate pricing bar chart with dramatic gap emphasis."""
    items = list(reversed(data))
    names = [SHORT_NAMES.get(d[0], d[0]) for d in items]
    values = [d[1] for d in items]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5), dpi=200)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
    ax.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)

    colors = []
    for d in items:
        if d[1] >= 10:
            colors.append(ROSE)  # most expensive
        elif d[1] <= 0.50:
            colors.append(TEAL)  # cheapest
        else:
            colors.append(AMBER)

    bars = ax.barh(names, values, color=colors, height=0.65, zorder=3)

    for bar, val in zip(bars, values):
        ax.text(bar.get_width() + 0.15, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                f'${val:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRI, fontfamily='sans-serif')

    ax.set_xlim(0, 11.5)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SEC, labelsize=8.5, pad=4)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', colors=TEXT_PRI, labelsize=8.5)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)
    ax.grid(axis='x', color=BORDER, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=0)
    ax.set_xlabel('USD per 1M tokens (blended input/output)', fontsize=8, color=TEXT_SEC,
                  fontfamily='sans-serif')
    ax.set_title('Pricing Landscape', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRI,
                 pad=12, fontfamily='sans-serif', loc='left')

    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.5)
    fig.savefig(filename, dpi=200, facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor='none',
                bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.15)
    plt.close(fig)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MAIN POSTER COMPOSITION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def compose_poster():
    """Compose the full A1 poster from generated chart images."""
    print(f"Creating A1 portrait poster ({W_PX}x{H_PX} px at {DPI} DPI)...")

    poster = Image.new('RGB', (W_PX, H_PX), BG_DARK)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(poster)

    # Load fonts
    try:
        font_title = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD, 96)
        font_subtitle = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_REGULAR, 36)
        font_section = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD, 48)
        font_body = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_REGULAR, 32)
        font_stat_num = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD, 90)
        font_stat_label = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_MEDIUM, 26)
        font_stat_context = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_REGULAR, 22)
        font_callout = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD, 38)
        font_small = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_REGULAR, 24)
        font_insight = ImageFont.truetype(FONT_MEDIUM, 28)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Font loading error: {e}, using default")
        font_title = ImageFont.load_default()
        font_subtitle = font_title
        font_section = font_title
        font_body = font_title
        font_stat_num = font_title
        font_stat_label = font_title
        font_stat_context = font_title
        font_callout = font_title

def section_label(draw, text, x, y, font, color):
    """Draw a small section label with accent bar."""
    draw.rectangle([(x, y + 6), (x + 4, y + 24)], fill=color)
    draw.text((x + 14, y), text, fill=color, font=font)

def make_hbar_chart(data, title, xlabel, filename, color, top_n=None,
                    highlight_names=None, highlight_color=None,
                    value_fmt='{}', sort_reverse=False):
    """Generate a horizontal bar chart saved as PNG."""
    items = list(reversed(data))  # matplotlib draws bottom-up
    names = [SHORT_NAMES.get(d[0], d[0]) for d in items]
    values = [d[1] for d in items]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5), dpi=200)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
    ax.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)

    bar_colors = []
    for d in items:
        if highlight_names and d[0] in highlight_names:
            bar_colors.append(highlight_color or color)
        else:
            bar_colors.append(color)

    bars = ax.barh(names, values, color=bar_colors, height=0.65, zorder=3)

    # Value labels
    for bar, val in zip(bars, values):
        ax.text(bar.get_width() + max(values) * 0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                value_fmt.format(val), va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRI, fontfamily='sans-serif')

    ax.set_xlim(0, max(values) * 1.18)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SEC, labelsize=8.5, pad=4)
    ax.xaxis.set_tick_params(colors=TEXT_SEC)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', colors=TEXT_PRI, labelsize=8.5)
    ax.xaxis.label.set_color(TEXT_SEC)
    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel, fontsize=8, color=TEXT_SEC, fontfamily='sans-serif')

    # Remove spines
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)
    ax.grid(axis='x', color=BORDER, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

    # Title
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRI,
                 pad=12, fontfamily='sans-serif', loc='left')

    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.5)
    fig.savefig(filename, dpi=200, facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor='none',
                bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.15)
    plt.close(fig)


def make_tradeoff_chart(filename):
    """Generate the hero trade-off bubble chart: Intelligence vs Speed, bubble = 1/cost."""
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, 8.5), dpi=200)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
    ax.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)

    x_vals = []
    y_vals = []
    s_vals = []
    c_vals = []
    labels = []

    for name, (iq, speed, price) in tradeoff_models.items():
        x_vals.append(iq)
        y_vals.append(speed)
        # Bubble size proportional to value (1/price), scaled
        s_vals.append((1/price) * 1800)
        c_vals.append(MODEL_COLORS.get(name, CYAN))
        labels.append(SHORT_NAMES.get(name, name))

    # Plot bubbles
    scatter = ax.scatter(x_vals, y_vals, s=s_vals, c=c_vals, alpha=0.85,
                         edgecolors='white', linewidths=1.2, zorder=5)

    # Label key models
    label_offsets = {
        "Gemini 3.1 Pro": (2, -10),
        "GPT-5.4": (2, -6),
        "Claude Opus 4.6": (4, -4),
        "Grok 4.20": (3, 5),
        "Gemini 3 Flash": (-3, 8),
        "gpt-oss-120B": (-4, -8),
        "DeepSeek V3.2": (4, 4),
        "Nemotron 3 Super": (-5, -6),
        "Claude Sonnet 4.6": (3, 3),
        "GLM-5.1": (3, -4),
    }

    for i, label in enumerate(labels):
        ox, oy = label_offsets.get(label, (2, 2))
        ax.annotate(label, (x_vals[i], y_vals[i]),
                    textcoords="offset points", xytext=(ox, oy),
                    fontsize=8, color=TEXT_PRI, fontweight='bold',
                    fontfamily='sans-serif',
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=TEXT_DIM, lw=0.8),
                    zorder=10)

    # Quadrant annotations
    ax.annotate('Smart & Slow\nPremium Tier', xy=(55.2, 28), fontsize=7.5,
                color=TEXT_DIM, ha='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', fontstyle='italic')
    ax.annotate('Smart & Fast\nIdeal Balance', xy=(55.2, 185), fontsize=7.5,
                color=TEXT_DIM, ha='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', fontstyle='italic')
    ax.annotate('Budget & Fast\nValue Zone', xy=(35, 185), fontsize=7.5,
                color=TEXT_DIM, ha='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', fontstyle='italic')
    ax.annotate('Budget & Slow\nNiche Use', xy=(35, 28), fontsize=7.5,
                color=TEXT_DIM, ha='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', fontstyle='italic')

    # Reference lines at median
    ax.axhline(y=np.median(y_vals), color=BORDER, linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, zorder=1)
    ax.axvline(x=np.median(x_vals), color=BORDER, linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, zorder=1)

    ax.set_xlabel('Intelligence Score (AA Index v4.0)  →', fontsize=10, color=TEXT_SEC,
                  fontfamily='sans-serif', labelpad=8)
    ax.set_ylabel('Output Speed (tokens/sec)  →', fontsize=10, color=TEXT_SEC,
                  fontfamily='sans-serif', labelpad=8)
    ax.set_title('Intelligence vs. Speed vs. Cost', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold',
                 color=TEXT_PRI, pad=14, fontfamily='sans-serif', loc='left')

    # Subtitle annotation
    ax.text(0.0, 1.02, 'Bubble size = value (1/price). Larger bubble = more affordable.',
            transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8.5, color=TEXT_DIM,
            fontfamily='sans-serif', fontstyle='italic')

    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SEC, labelsize=9)
    ax.grid(True, color=BORDER, linewidth=0.4, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)

    ax.set_xlim(28, 62)
    ax.set_ylim(10, 235)

    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.8)
    fig.savefig(filename, dpi=200, facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor='none',
                bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.2)
    plt.close(fig)


def make_price_chart(data, filename):
    """Generate pricing bar chart with dramatic gap emphasis."""
    items = list(reversed(data))
    names = [SHORT_NAMES.get(d[0], d[0]) for d in items]
    values = [d[1] for d in items]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5), dpi=200)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
    ax.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)

    colors = []
    for d in items:
        if d[1] >= 10:
            colors.append(ROSE)  # most expensive
        elif d[1] <= 0.50:
            colors.append(TEAL)  # cheapest
        else:
            colors.append(AMBER)

    bars = ax.barh(names, values, color=colors, height=0.65, zorder=3)

    for bar, val in zip(bars, values):
        ax.text(bar.get_width() + 0.15, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                f'${val:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRI, fontfamily='sans-serif')

    ax.set_xlim(0, 11.5)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SEC, labelsize=8.5, pad=4)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', colors=TEXT_PRI, labelsize=8.5)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)
    ax.grid(axis='x', color=BORDER, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=0)
    ax.set_xlabel('USD per 1M tokens (blended input/output)', fontsize=8, color=TEXT_SEC,

    fig.savefig(filename, dpi=200, facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor='none',
                bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.15)

def section_label(draw, text, x, y, font, color):

def draw_card_bg(ax, accent_color=None, accent_pos='top'):

def make_bar_ax(ax, data, title, xlabel, bar_color, highlight_indices=None,
                highlight_color=None, value_fmt='{}'):
    """Draw a horizontal bar chart on an existing axis."""
    items = list(reversed(data))
    names = [SHORT_NAMES.get(d[0], d[0]) for d in items]

    colors = []
    for i in range(len(items)):
        if highlight_indices and i in highlight_indices:
            colors.append(highlight_color or bar_color)
        else:
            colors.append(bar_color)

    for spine in ax_title.spines.values():

def draw_card_bg(ax, accent_color=None, accent_pos='top'):
    """Style an axis as a dark card."""
    ax.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)
    if accent_color:
        if accent_pos == 'top':
            ax.axhline(y=1.0, xmin=0, xmax=1, color=accent_color,
                       linewidth=3, transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)
        elif accent_pos == 'left':
            ax.axvline(x=0.0, ymin=0, ymax=1, color=accent_color,
                       linewidth=4, transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)


def section_label(fig, text, x, y, color):
    """Draw a small ALL-CAPS section label."""
    fig.text(x, y, text.upper(), fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
             color=color, ha='left', va='bottom', family=FONT)


def make_bar_ax(ax, data, title, xlabel, bar_color, highlight_indices=None,
                highlight_color=None, value_fmt='{}'):
    """Draw a horizontal bar chart on an existing axis."""
    items = list(reversed(data))
    names = [SHORT_NAMES.get(d[0], d[0]) for d in items]
    values = [d[1] for d in items]

    colors = []
    for i in range(len(items)):
        if highlight_indices and i in highlight_indices:
            colors.append(highlight_color or bar_color)
        else:
            colors.append(bar_color)

    bars = ax.barh(names, values, color=colors, height=0.62, zorder=3)

    max_val = max(values)
    for bar, val in zip(bars, values):
        ax.text(bar.get_width() + max_val * 0.015, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                value_fmt.format(val), va='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
                color=TEXT_PRI)

    ax.set_xlim(0, max_val * 1.22)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SEC, labelsize=10, pad=3)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', colors=TEXT_PRI, labelsize=10)
    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel, fontsize=9, color=TEXT_SEC, labelpad=6)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRI, pad=10, loc='left')
    ax.grid(axis='x', color=BORDER, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)

"""

Intelligence • Speed • Cost — Dark dashboard aesthetic.

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

import numpy as np

price_data = [

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# HELPER FUNCTIONS

def draw_card_bg(ax, accent_color=None, accent_pos='top'):
    """Style an axis as a dark card."""
    ax.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)
    if accent_color:
        if accent_pos == 'top':
            ax.axhline(y=1.0, xmin=0, xmax=1, color=accent_color,
                       linewidth=3, transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)
        elif accent_pos == 'left':
            ax.axvline(x=0.0, ymin=0, ymax=1, color=accent_color,
                       linewidth=4, transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)


def section_label(fig, text, x, y, color):
    """Draw a small ALL-CAPS section label."""
    fig.text(x, y, text.upper(), fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
             color=color, ha='left', va='bottom', family=FONT)


def make_bar_ax(ax, data, title, xlabel, bar_color, highlight_indices=None,
                highlight_color=None, value_fmt='{}'):
    """Draw a horizontal bar chart on an existing axis."""
    items = list(reversed(data))
    names = [SHORT_NAMES.get(d[0], d[0]) for d in items]
    values = [d[1] for d in items]

    colors = []
    for i in range(len(items)):
        if highlight_indices and i in highlight_indices:
            colors.append(highlight_color or bar_color)
        else:
            colors.append(bar_color)

    bars = ax.barh(names, values, color=colors, height=0.62, zorder=3)

    max_val = max(values)
    for bar, val in zip(bars, values):
        ax.text(bar.get_width() + max_val * 0.015, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                value_fmt.format(val), va='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
                color=TEXT_PRI)

    ax.set_xlim(0, max_val * 1.22)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SEC, labelsize=10, pad=3)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', colors=TEXT_PRI, labelsize=10)
    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel, fontsize=9, color=TEXT_SEC, labelpad=6)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRI, pad=10, loc='left')
    ax.grid(axis='x', color=BORDER, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# MAIN POSTER ASSEMBLY
# ═══════════════════════════════════════

def build_poster():
    print(f"Building A1 portrait poster ({W_IN:.1f}x{H_IN:.1f} inches, {DPI} DPI)...")

    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(W_IN, H_IN), dpi=DPI)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_DARK)

    # Layout coordinates in figure fraction (0-1, bottom-left origin)
    MARGIN_L = 0.04
    MARGIN_R = 0.96
    GAP = 0.012  # gap between side-by-side panels

    # ── TITLE BAR ──
    title_bottom, title_top = 0.865, 0.985
    ax_title = fig.add_axes([MARGIN_L, title_bottom, MARGIN_R - MARGIN_L, title_top - title_bottom])
    ax_title.set_facecolor(BG_RAISED)
    for spine in ax_title.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(True)
        spine.set_color(BORDER)
        spine.set_linewidth(1)
    ax_title.set_xticks([])
    ax_title.set_yticks([])

    # Accent stripe left
    ax_title.axvline(x=0.001, ymin=0, ymax=1, color=BLUE, linewidth=6,
                     transform=ax_title.transAxes, clip_on=False)

    # Title text
    ax_title.text(0.03, 0.72, "Frontier AI Models Compared",
                  transform=ax_title.transAxes, fontsize=46, fontweight='bold',
                  color=TEXT_PRI, va='center', family=FONT)
    ax_title.text(0.03, 0.32, "Intelligence  ·  Speed  ·  Cost",
                  transform=ax_title.transAxes, fontsize=20, color=TEXT_SEC,
                  va='center', family=FONT)
    ax_title.text(0.03, 0.10, "Based on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0   —   Independent analysis from artificialanalysis.ai   —   May 2026",
                  transform=ax_title.transAxes, fontsize=11, color=TEXT_DIM,
                  va='center', family=FONT)

    # ── STAT BANNER ──
    stat_bottom, stat_top = 0.78, 0.86
    ax_stat = fig.add_axes([MARGIN_L, stat_bottom, MARGIN_R - MARGIN_L, stat_top - stat_bottom])
    ax_stat.set_facecolor(BG_RAISED)
    for spine in ax_stat.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(True)
        spine.set_color(BORDER)
        spine.set_linewidth(1)
    ax_stat.set_xticks([])
    ax_stat.set_yticks([])

    stats = [
        ("57", "Intelligence\nLeaders", "Gemini 3.1 Pro &\nGPT-5.4 tied at top", BLUE),
        ("206", "Fastest\nSpeed", "gpt-oss-120B at\n206 tokens/sec", TEAL),
        ("33×", "Price\nRange", "$0.30 → $10.00\nper 1M tokens", AMBER),
        ("10", "Evaluations\nin Index", "Coding, agentic,\nknowledge & more", PURPLE),
    ]

    n_stats = len(stats)
    for i, (num, label, ctx, accent) in enumerate(stats):
        xc = (i + 0.5) / n_stats
        # Number
        ax_stat.text(xc, 0.62, num, transform=ax_stat.transAxes, fontsize=52,
                     fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRI, ha='center', va='center',
                     family=FONT)
        # Accent underline
        ax_stat.axhline(y=0.48, xmin=(i/n_stats)+0.05, xmax=((i+1)/n_stats)-0.05,
                        color=accent, linewidth=3, clip_on=False)
        # Label
        ax_stat.text(xc, 0.38, label, transform=ax_stat.transAxes, fontsize=14,
                     fontweight='bold', color=accent, ha='center', va='top',
                     family=FONT)
        # Context
        ax_stat.text(xc, 0.12, ctx, transform=ax_stat.transAxes, fontsize=9.5,
                     color=TEXT_DIM, ha='center', va='top', family=FONT,
                     linespacing=1.4)

        # Vertical dividers
        if i < n_stats - 1:
            ax_stat.axvline(x=(i+1)/n_stats, ymin=0.15, ymax=0.85,
                            color=BORDER, linewidth=1.5, clip_on=False)

    # ── INTELLIGENCE + SPEED CHARTS (side by side) ──
    charts_bottom, charts_top = 0.47, 0.765
    mid_x = 0.5
    chart_w = (MARGIN_R - mid_x) - GAP/2

    ax_intel = fig.add_axes([MARGIN_L, charts_bottom, mid_x - MARGIN_L - GAP/2, charts_top - charts_bottom])
    ax_intel.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
    for spine in ax_intel.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)

    intel_items = list(reversed(intelligence_data))
    intel_names = [SHORT_NAMES.get(d[0], d[0]) for d in intel_items]
    intel_vals = [d[1] for d in intel_items]
    intel_colors = [TEAL if d[1] >= 57 else BLUE for d in intel_items]

def make_bar_ax(ax, data, title, xlabel, bar_color, highlight_indices=None,
                highlight_color=None, value_fmt='{}'):
    """Draw a horizontal bar chart on an existing axis."""
    items = list(reversed(data))
    names = [SHORT_NAMES.get(d[0], d[0]) for d in items]
    values = [d[1] for d in items]

    colors = []
    for i in range(len(items)):
        if highlight_indices and i in highlight_indices:
            colors.append(highlight_color or bar_color)
        else:
            colors.append(bar_color)

    bars = ax.barh(names, values, color=colors, height=0.62, zorder=3)

    max_val = max(values)
    for bar, val in zip(bars, values):
        ax.text(bar.get_width() + max_val * 0.015, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                value_fmt.format(val), va='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
                color=TEXT_PRI)

    ax.set_xlim(0, max_val * 1.22)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SEC, labelsize=10, pad=3)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', colors=TEXT_PRI, labelsize=10)
    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel, fontsize=9, color=TEXT_SEC, labelpad=6)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRI, pad=10, loc='left')
    ax.grid(axis='x', color=BORDER, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)
